editorial:
Imagine you have a steady job and a quiet life, but then you decide to steal a million dollars right before the weekend. That is exactly what happens to the bank manager played by Joseph Cotten. He thinks he has the perfect plan to get away with the money and fly off to Brazil while everyone is off for the holidays. The movie feels like a ticking clock, and you can really feel the stress as his simple plan starts to fall apart. It is a classic crime story that keeps you guessing if he will actually make it out of town or if the law will catch up to him first.

What really makes this one work is how the tension builds up. The acting is top-notch, and the twists keep you on your toes without being too confusing. While some of the 1950s pacing might feel a bit slow at first, the payoff is totally worth it. If you love old-school crime dramas, you should definitely check this out. You can find it for rent on Apple TV or stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move.
endingExplained: At the very end, the bank manager thinks he has finally won and is ready to leave. However, the police have been one step ahead of him the whole time. He gets trapped in a clever setup where he thinks he is escaping, but he is actually walking right into the arms of the law. He is arrested just as he thinks he is free, proving that his perfect crime was actually a trap.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old crime movies and heist stories.
